author: JDBurke
quote:
Not at all like ANY of the ENTIRE franchise. **** disappointed. IDK if they don't understand what players mean by "realistic" and "real life".... We want more available options to do things without the restrictions. Real life has real boundaries from real punishments. The game is meant to be able to defy those boundaries. This type of game is designed for the player to let loose and cause chaos and wreck havoc. This game is way too controlled and it pisses me off. I don't know if I can play the whole way through to be honest. Can't even open carry on your own property. Also, some of these missions are PUSHED THROUGH like **** ass WOLVERINE. 

I want to shoot-up whoever I want, where ever I want, but NOOOOOOOOOO these developers went SOFT AS ****.
